findings.note: source_path is declared only as type string with minLength 1 while data-model.md 2.1 says it follows the same path validation rules as path; cosmetic since the schema self-declares as advisory with procedural _relative_path validation authoritative, but applying the same pattern would close it.

The planted canary constant is the AWS-docs example access key ID but is labeled aws_secret_access_key; detection still fires (AWSKeyDetector matches the key-ID pattern, empirically confirmed), so the positive control is sound - the label is merely a mislabel.

The coverage assertion counts submitted argv paths, not scanner-confirmed scanned files (the baseline output does not enumerate scanned files). The plan states this honestly and compensates with the planted-secret positive control; recorded so implementers do not mistake the count check for scanner-side proof.
